command_line:
set -eu
python3 -m pip install --no-deps --target .deps 'caper==2.2.2' > pip.log 2>&1 || python3 -m pip install --no-deps --target .deps caper >> pip.log 2>&1
PYTHONPATH=".deps${PYTHONPATH:+:\$PYTHONPATH}" PATH="\$PWD/.deps/bin:\$PATH" caper --help > caper_help.txt 2>&1
PYTHONPATH=".deps${PYTHONPATH:+:\$PYTHONPATH}" PATH="\$PWD/.deps/bin:\$PATH" caper run --help > caper_run_help.txt 2>&1
{
  echo '--- pip ---'
  sed -n '1,120p' pip.log
  echo '--- caper help ---'
  sed -n '1,120p' caper_help.txt
  echo '--- caper run help ---'
  sed -n '1,180p' caper_run_help.txt
} > caper_probe.txt
